`tiebreak=shuffle, seed=3` with `skip_weekends` and `skip_holidays` from the start, so each Monday-to-Monday shift is worth 5 units, less when the Friday 2026-07-03 or the Monday 2026-09-07 holiday falls inside it (the 08-31 shift loses the 9 hours of Labor Day before 09:00, hence carol=19.63 after rounding to two decimals). Ties are broken by the lowest FNV-1a hash of `seed|rotation|start|member`, so the sequence looks irregular but is a pure function of the ledger: a second run on the output reproduces it, and changing the seed would change it. Alice and bob (15) are the lowest at the snapshot and the shuffle picks alice for the current shift and bob for 09-14.
